passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state that eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 90 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2035, 95 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2040, 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2045, and 100 percent of electricity procured to serve all state agencies by December 31, 2035.
passages.note: Chaptered bill, Laird named as author in the Legislative Counsel's Digest; operative section accelerates the RPS mandate with firm interim deadlines.

rows.reasoning: As author of the chaptered SB 1020 (2021-2022), Laird advanced a revision to Public Utilities Code Section 454.53 requiring eligible renewable and zero-carbon resources to supply 90% of retail electricity sales by December 31, 2035, 95% by 2040, and 100% by 2045 (moved earlier than prior law). This matches rung 1's text, 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
